bugs.description: INJECTED (return-value-dropped): Return value dropped in an exported function; callers still use the result. `return <value>` replaced by an empty return in `auth` (callers still consume the result). Mutated src/utils/basic-auth.ts:25: `return { username: userPass[1], password: userPass[2] }` -> `return;`. The bug manifests in src/middleware/basic-auth/index.ts:78: `const requestUser = auth(ctx.req.raw)`.
